    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 40px;
      height: 68px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      transition: box-shadow 0.3s;
    }
    .header.scrolled { box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 20px;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      color: var(--black);
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .logo-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: #fff; }

    .header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }

    .btn-login {
      padding: 9px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--black);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-login:hover { background: var(--black); color: #fff; }

    /* Hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      width: 28px;
      padding: 4px 0;
    }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--black);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
      transform-origin: center;
    }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* Mobile Nav Overlay */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 99;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(-10px);
      transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open {
      display: flex;
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
      pointer-events: all;
    }
    .mobile-nav a {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      padding: 12px 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    .mobile-nav a:hover { color: var(--purple); }
    .mobile-nav .mobile-login {
      margin-top: 16px;
      padding: 14px 48px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--black);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .mobile-nav .mobile-login:hover { background: var(--purple); color: #fff; }

    /* ─── Hero ─── */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 120px 40px 80px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #fff;
    }

    /* Gradient mesh background */
    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      z-index: 0;
    }
    .hero-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(80px);
      opacity: 0.22;
    }
    .hero-blob-1 {
      width: 700px; height: 700px;
      background: var(--purple);
      top: -150px; right: -100px;
    }
    .hero-blob-2 {
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: var(--orange);
      bottom: -100px; left: -100px;
    }
    .hero-blob-3 {
      width: 400px; height: 400px;
      background: #FF3CA0;
      top: 50%; left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    }

    /* Geometric accent shapes */
    .hero-shape {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-shape-1 {
      width: 180px; height: 180px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(118,56,250,0.15);
      top: 18%; right: 12%;
      animation: float1 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .hero-shape-2 {
      width: 80px; height: 80px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange) 0%, #FFB347 100%);
      opacity: 0.18;
      bottom: 28%; right: 20%;
      animation: float2 8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .hero-shape-3 {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      background: var(--purple);
      opacity: 0.25;
      top: 32%; left: 8%;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transform: rotate(20deg);
      animation: float3 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes float1 { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-18px)} }
    @keyframes float2 { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(14px)} }
    @keyframes float3 { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(20deg)} 50%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(35deg)} }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      max-width: 900px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(118,56,250,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(118,56,250,0.2);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--purple);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 6px; height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--purple);
      animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%,100%{opacity:1; transform:scale(1)}
      50%{opacity:0.5; transform:scale(0.8)}
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(40px, 7vw, 80px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -2.5px;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .hero-title .highlight {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple) 0%, #FF3CA0 50%, var(--orange) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 16px 40px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, #5A28D4 100%);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
      transition: all 0.25s;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(118,56,250,0.35);
    }
    .hero-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(118,56,250,0.45);
    }
    .hero-cta svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 2.5; }

    /* App preview mockup */
    .hero-phones {
      position: relative;
      margin-top: 72px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 24px;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .phone-mockup {
      width: 200px;
      border-radius: 36px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      transform-origin: bottom center;
    }
    .phone-mockup:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-5deg) translateY(20px); }
    .phone-mockup:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.05); z-index: 3; box-shadow: 0 40px 100px rgba(118,56,250,0.3); }
    .phone-mockup:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(5deg) translateY(20px); }
    .phone-screen {
      aspect-ratio: 9/19;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 30%, #0f3460 60%, #533483 100%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 24px 16px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .phone-screen-1 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #ff6b6b 0%, #ffd93d 50%, #ff6b6b 100%); }
    .phone-screen-2 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #7638FA 0%, #FF3CA0 50%, #FF7A00 100%); }
    .phone-screen-3 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #11998e 0%, #38ef7d 100%); }

    .phone-content {
      width: 100%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 12px;
    }
    .phone-avatar { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .phone-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .phone-bar:last-child { width: 60%; }
    .phone-icons { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; margin-top: 16px; }
    .phone-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }

    /* ─── Section Shared ─── */
    .section { padding: 100px 40px; }
    .section-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }

    /* ─── Features Section ─── */
    .features { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }
    .features-text {
      padding: 64px 56px;
      background: #fff;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--purple);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .section-headline {
      font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.2px;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .section-headline a {
      color: var(--purple);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .section-headline a:hover { color: var(--purple-dark); }
    .section-desc {
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .section-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .section-link:hover { gap: 12px; }
    .section-link svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.5; }

    .features-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0ebff 0%, #e8f4ff 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 48px;
      min-height: 400px;
    }
    .feature-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .feature-pill {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(118,56,250,0.1);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .feature-pill:hover { transform: translateX(4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(118,56,250,0.18); }
    .feature-pill-icon {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    /* ─── Safety Section ─── */
    .safety { background: #fff; }
    .safety-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }
    .safety-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0fff4 0%, #e8f9ff 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 48px;
      min-height: 400px;
    }
    .safety-cards {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .safety-card {
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .safety-card-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .safety-card-text { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--black); }
    .safety-card-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-400); font-weight: 500; margin-top: 2px; }

    .safety-text {
      padding: 64px 56px;
      background: #fff;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .safety .section-link { color: #00a86b; }
    .safety .section-label { color: #00a86b; }

    /* ─── Creators Section ─── */
    .creators {
      background: var(--black);
      color: #fff;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .creators-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .creators-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(100px);
    }
    .creators-blob-1 { width: 600px; height: 600px; background: var(--purple); opacity: 0.25; top: -200px; right: -100px; }
    .creators-blob-2 { width: 400px; height: 400px; background: var(--orange); opacity: 0.2; bottom: -100px; left: -100px; }

    .creators-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .creators .section-label { color: var(--orange); }
    .creators .section-headline { color: #fff; }
    .creators .section-headline a { color: var(--orange); }
    .creators .section-desc { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }
    .creators .section-link { color: var(--orange); }

    .creators-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .creator-stat {
      padding: 28px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .creator-stat:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
    .creator-stat-num {
      font-size: 36px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple-light), var(--orange));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .creator-stat-label { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ─── Tagline Banner ─── */
    .tagline-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, #FF3CA0 50%, var(--orange) 100%);
      padding: 80px 40px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .tagline-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.05'%3E%3Ccircle cx='30' cy='30' r='2'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E") repeat;
    }
    .tagline-text {
      position: relative;
      font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    /* ─── News Section ─── */
    .news { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .news-heading {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      color: var(--black);
    }
    .news-view-more {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .news-view-more:hover { gap: 12px; }
    .news-view-more svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.5; }

    /* Carousel wrapper */
    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }
    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      cursor: grab;
    }
    .carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .carousel-track.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 320px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }
    .news-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }

    .news-thumb {
      height: 200px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .news-thumb-inner {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
    }
    /* Unique gradient per card */
    .news-thumb-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7638FA 0%, #FF3CA0 100%); }
    .news-thumb-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A00 0%, #FFB347 100%); }
    .news-thumb-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00b4d8 0%, #7638FA 100%); }
    .news-thumb-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ecc71 0%, #00b4d8 100%); }

    .news-card-body { padding: 24px; }
    .news-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .news-tag {
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .tag-announcements { background: rgba(118,56,250,0.1); color: var(--purple); }
    .tag-tips { background: rgba(255,122,0,0.1); color: var(--orange); }
    .tag-product { background: rgba(0,180,216,0.1); color: #00b4d8; }
    .tag-safety { background: rgba(0,168,107,0.1); color: #00a86b; }

    .news-card-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .news-card-date {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Carousel nav buttons */
    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 10;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { background: var(--purple); border-color: var(--purple); }
    .carousel-btn:hover svg { stroke: #fff; }
    .carousel-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; stroke: var(--black); stroke-width: 2.5; transition: stroke 0.2s; }
    .carousel-btn-prev { left: -22px; }
    .carousel-btn-next { right: -22px; }
    .carousel-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .carousel-btn:disabled:hover { background: #fff; border-color: var(--gray-200); }
    .carousel-btn:disabled:hover svg { stroke: var(--black); }

    /* Carousel dots */
    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }
    .carousel-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      transition: all 0.3s;
      border: none;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .carousel-dot.active {
      background: var(--purple);
      width: 24px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    /* ─── CTA Download ─── */
    .cta-download {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 100px 40px;

    // ─── Header scroll shadow ───
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    // ─── Hamburger / Mobile Nav ───
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');
    let navOpen = false;

    function openNav() {
      navOpen = true;
      hamburger.classList.add('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      mobileNav.style.display = 'flex';
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        mobileNav.classList.add('open');
      });
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeNav() {
      navOpen = false;
      hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!navOpen) mobileNav.style.display = 'none';
      }, 300);
    }

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (navOpen) closeNav(); else openNav();
    });

    // Close on ESC
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && navOpen) closeNav();
    });

    // ─── News Carousel ───
    const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.news-card');
    const CARD_WIDTH = 320 + 20; // card width + gap
    let currentIndex = 0;

    function updateCarousel(idx) {
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, cards.length - 1));
      track.scrollTo({ left: currentIndex * CARD_WIDTH, behavior: 'smooth' });
      updateDots();
      updateButtons();
    }

    function updateDots() {
      dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
        const active = i === currentIndex;
        dot.classList.toggle('active', active);
        dot.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
    }

    function updateButtons() {
      prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= cards.length - 1;
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => updateCarousel(currentIndex - 1));
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => updateCarousel(currentIndex + 1));

    dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
      dot.addEventListener('click', () => updateCarousel(i));
    });

    // Sync dots on manual scroll
    let scrollTimer;
    track.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      clearTimeout(scrollTimer);
      scrollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const idx = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / CARD_WIDTH);
        currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, cards.length - 1));
        updateDots();
        updateButtons();
      }, 80);
    }, { passive: true });

    // Touch/drag support for desktop
    let isDragging = false;
    let startX = 0;
    let startScroll = 0;

    track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.pageX;
      startScroll = track.scrollLeft;
      track.classList.add('dragging');
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const dx = e.pageX - startX;
      track.scrollLeft = startScroll - dx;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      isDragging = false;
      track.classList.remove('dragging');
      const idx = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / CARD_WIDTH);
      updateCarousel(Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, cards.length - 1)));
    });

    // Prevent link clicks during drag
    track.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (Math.abs(track.scrollLeft - startScroll) > 5) e.preventDefault();
    });

    updateButtons();

    // ─── Scroll Reveal ───
    const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    revealEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <style>
    /* ─── Reset & Base ─── */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      background: #fff;
      color: #0a0a0a;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    button { cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; font-family: inherit; }

    /* ─── CSS Variables ─── */
    :root {
      --purple: #7638FA;
      --purple-light: #9B6FFC;
      --purple-dark: #5A28D4;
      --orange: #FF7A00;
      --orange-light: #FF9B40;
      --black: #0a0a0a;
      --gray-100: #f5f5f7;
      --gray-200: #e8e8ed;
      --gray-400: #999;
      --gray-600: #555;
      --white: #fff;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 16px;
      --radius-lg: 24px;
      --radius-xl: 32px;
      --shadow-card: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-hover: 0 8px 40px rgba(118,56,250,0.18), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }

    /* ─── Header ─── */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 40px;
      height: 68px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      transition: box-shadow 0.3s;
    }
    .header.scrolled { box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 20px;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      color: var(--black);

      border-radius: 10px;

    .logo-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: #fff; }

      gap: 5px;
      width: 28px;
      padding: 4px 0;

      display: block;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--black);

      transform-origin: center;

    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    .mobile-nav {

      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 99;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98);

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;

      transform: translateY(-10px);
      transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
      pointer-events: none;

    .mobile-nav.open {
      display: flex;
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
      pointer-events: all;

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 700;

    /* ─── Hero ─── */

    @keyframes float1 { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-18px)} }

    .hero-content {

      font-size: clamp(40px, 7vw, 80px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -2.5px;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .hero-title .highlight {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple) 0%, #FF3CA0 50%, var(--orange) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 16px 40px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, #5A28D4 100%);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
      transition: all 0.25s;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(118,56,250,0.35);
    }
    .hero-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(118,56,250,0.45);
    }
    .hero-cta svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 2.5; }

    /* App preview mockup */
    .hero-phones {
      position: relative;
      margin-top: 72px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 24px;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .phone-mockup {
      width: 200px;
      border-radius: 36px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      transform-origin: bottom center;
    }
    .phone-mockup:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-5deg) translateY(20px); }
    .phone-mockup:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.05); z-index: 3; box-shadow: 0 40px 100px rgba(118,56,250,0.3); }
    .phone-mockup:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(5deg) translateY(20px); }
    .phone-screen {
      aspect-ratio: 9/19;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 30%, #0f3460 60%, #533483 100%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 24px 16px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .phone-screen-1 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #ff6b6b 0%, #ffd93d 50%, #ff6b6b 100%); }
    .phone-screen-2 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #7638FA 0%, #FF3CA0 50%, #FF7A00 100%); }
    .phone-screen-3 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #11998e 0%, #38ef7d 100%); }

    .phone-content {
      width: 100%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 12px;
    }
    .phone-avatar { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .phone-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .phone-bar:last-child { width: 60%; }
    .phone-icons { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; margin-top: 16px; }
    .phone-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }

    /* ─── Section Shared ─── */
    .section { padding: 100px 40px; }
    .section-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }

    /* ─── Features Section ─── */
    .features { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }
    .features-text {
      padding: 64px 56px;
      background: #fff;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--purple);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .section-headline {
      font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.2px;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .section-headline a {
      color: var(--purple);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .section-headline a:hover { color: var(--purple-dark); }
    .section-desc {
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .section-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .section-link:hover { gap: 12px; }
    .section-link svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.5; }

    .features-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0ebff 0%, #e8f4ff 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 48px;
      min-height: 400px;
    }
    .feature-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .feature-pill {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(118,56,250,0.1);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .feature-pill:hover { transform: translateX(4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(118,56,250,0.18); }
    .feature-pill-icon {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    /* ─── Safety Section ─── */
    .safety { background: #fff; }
    .safety-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }
    .safety-visual {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0fff4 0%, #e8f9ff 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 48px;
      min-height: 400px;
    }
    .safety-cards {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .safety-card {
      padding: 18px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .safety-card-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .safety-card-text { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--black); }
    .safety-card-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-400); font-weight: 500; margin-top: 2px; }

    .safety-text {
      padding: 64px 56px;
      background: #fff;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .safety .section-link { color: #00a86b; }
    .safety .section-label { color: #00a86b; }

    /* ─── Creators Section ─── */
    .creators {
      background: var(--black);
      color: #fff;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .creators-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .creators-blob {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(100px);
    }
    .creators-blob-1 { width: 600px; height: 600px; background: var(--purple); opacity: 0.25; top: -200px; right: -100px; }
    .creators-blob-2 { width: 400px; height: 400px; background: var(--orange); opacity: 0.2; bottom: -100px; left: -100px; }

    .creators-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .creators .section-label { color: var(--orange); }
    .creators .section-headline { color: #fff; }
    .creators .section-headline a { color: var(--orange); }
    .creators .section-desc { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }
    .creators .section-link { color: var(--orange); }

    .creators-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .creator-stat {
      padding: 28px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .creator-stat:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
    .creator-stat-num {
      font-size: 36px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple-light), var(--orange));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .creator-stat-label { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ─── Tagline Banner ─── */
    .tagline-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, #FF3CA0 50%, var(--orange) 100%);
      padding: 80px 40px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .tagline-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.05'%3E%3Ccircle cx='30' cy='30' r='2'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E") repeat;
    }
    .tagline-text {
      position: relative;
      font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    /* ─── News Section ─── */
    .news { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .news-heading {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      color: var(--black);
    }
    .news-view-more {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }
    .news-view-more:hover { gap: 12px; }
    .news-view-more svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.5; }

    /* Carousel wrapper */
    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }
    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      cursor: grab;
    }
    .carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .carousel-track.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 320px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }
    .news-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover); }

    .news-thumb {
      height: 200px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .news-thumb-inner {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
    }
    /* Unique gradient per card */
    .news-thumb-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7638FA 0%, #FF3CA0 100%); }
    .news-thumb-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A00 0%, #FFB347 100%); }
    .news-thumb-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00b4d8 0%, #7638FA 100%); }
    .news-thumb-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ecc71 0%, #00b4d8 100%); }

    .news-card-body { padding: 24px; }
    .news-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .news-tag {
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .tag-announcements { background: rgba(118,56,250,0.1); color: var(--purple); }
    .tag-tips { background: rgba(255,122,0,0.1); color: var(--orange); }
    .tag-product { background: rgba(0,180,216,0.1); color: #00b4d8; }
    .tag-safety { background: rgba(0,168,107,0.1); color: #00a86b; }

    .news-card-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .news-card-date {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Carousel nav buttons */
    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 10;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { background: var(--purple); border-color: var(--purple); }
    .carousel-btn:hover svg { stroke: #fff; }
    .carousel-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; stroke: var(--black); stroke-width: 2.5; transition: stroke 0.2s; }
    .carousel-btn-prev { left: -22px; }
    .carousel-btn-next { right: -22px; }
    .carousel-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .carousel-btn:disabled:hover { background: #fff; border-color: var(--gray-200); }
    .carousel-btn:disabled:hover svg { stroke: var(--black); }

    /* Carousel dots */
    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }
    .carousel-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      transition: all 0.3s;
      border: none;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .carousel-dot.active {
      background: var(--purple);
      width: 24px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    /* ─── CTA Download ─── */
    .cta-download {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 100px 40px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .cta-download-inner { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .cta-download-headline {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 60px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      line-height: 1.05;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .cta-download-sub {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      margin-bottom: 44px;
    }
    .store-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .store-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: var(--black);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--black);
    }
    .store-btn:hover { background: var(--purple); border-color: var(--purple); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(118,56,250,0.3); }
    .store-btn svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: #fff; }
    .store-btn-text-sm { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.75; display: block; }
    .store-btn-text-lg { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; display: block; }

    /* ─── Footer ─── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--black);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 72px 40px 40px;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 40px;
      padding-bottom: 56px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .footer-brand { grid-column: 1; }
    .footer-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 18px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      color: #fff;
    }
    .footer-logo-icon {
      width: 32px; height: 32px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--orange) 100%);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .footer-logo-icon svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: #fff; }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      line-height: 1.65;
      font-weight: 500;
      max-width: 220px;
    }
    .footer-col-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .footer-links { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 11px; }
    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.2s;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .footer-links a:hover { color: #fff; }
    .footer-links a .ext { font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.5; }

    .footer-bottom {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 32px auto 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .footer-bottom-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

    .lang-selector {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      font-weight: 500;
      background: transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
    }
    .lang-selector:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); color: #fff; }
    .lang-selector svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; }

    .social-icons { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .social-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.2s;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    }
    .social-icon:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color: #fff; }
    .social-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .footer-legal a:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
    .footer-legal span { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); font-size: 12px; }

    /* ─── Scroll Animations ─── */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(32px);
      transition: opacity 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    .reveal.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
    .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
    .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }

    /* ─── Responsive ─── */
    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .features-grid, .safety-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .features-visual, .safety-visual { min-height: 280px; }
      .creators-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .header { padding: 0 20px; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .btn-login { display: none; }

      .hero { padding: 100px 20px 60px; }
      .hero-phones { display: none; }

  <script>
    // ─── Header scroll shadow ───
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    // ─── Hamburger / Mobile Nav ───
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');
    let navOpen = false;

    function openNav() {
      navOpen = true;
      hamburger.classList.add('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      mobileNav.style.display = 'flex';
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        mobileNav.classList.add('open');
      });
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeNav() {
      navOpen = false;
      hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!navOpen) mobileNav.style.display = 'none';
      }, 300);
    }

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (navOpen) closeNav(); else openNav();
    });

    // Close on ESC
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && navOpen) closeNav();
    });

    // ─── News Carousel ───
    const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.news-card');
    const CARD_WIDTH = 320 + 20; // card width + gap
    let currentIndex = 0;

    function updateCarousel(idx) {
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, cards.length - 1));
      track.scrollTo({ left: currentIndex * CARD_WIDTH, behavior: 'smooth' });
      updateDots();
      updateButtons();
    }

    function updateDots() {
      dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
        const active = i === currentIndex;
        dot.classList.toggle('active', active);
        dot.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
    }

    function updateButtons() {
      prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
      nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= cards.length - 1;
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => updateCarousel(currentIndex - 1));
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => updateCarousel(currentIndex + 1));

    dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
      dot.addEventListener('click', () => updateCarousel(i));
    });

    // Sync dots on manual scroll
    let scrollTimer;
    track.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      clearTimeout(scrollTimer);
      scrollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const idx = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / CARD_WIDTH);
        currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, cards.length - 1));
        updateDots();
        updateButtons();
      }, 80);
    }, { passive: true });

    // Touch/drag support for desktop
    let isDragging = false;
    let startX = 0;
    let startScroll = 0;

    track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.pageX;
      startScroll = track.scrollLeft;
      track.classList.add('dragging');
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const dx = e.pageX - startX;
      track.scrollLeft = startScroll - dx;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      isDragging = false;
      track.classList.remove('dragging');
      const idx = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / CARD_WIDTH);
      updateCarousel(Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, cards.length - 1)));
    });

    // Prevent link clicks during drag
    track.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (Math.abs(track.scrollLeft - startScroll) > 5) e.preventDefault();
    });

    updateButtons();

    // ─── Scroll Reveal ───
    const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    revealEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>
</body>

steps.message:
The SnapFrame About page is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what was built:

**Design direction:** Vibrant Editorial — light background, bold oversized type, purple/magenta/orange gradient moments against white space.

**Sections (in order):**
- **Header** — fixed glass-morphism bar with SnapFrame logo, "Log in" button, and hamburger icon (mobile)
- **Hero** — full-viewport with animated gradient mesh blobs, floating geometric shapes, gradient headline, "Try it now" CTA, and trio of phone mockups
- **Features** — two-column card with feature pills (Clips, Stories, DMs, Search & Explore)
- **Safety** — reversed two-column layout with softer green accent; safety tool cards with icons
- **Creators** — dark section with purple/orange blob atmosphere and a 2×2 stats grid
- **Tagline Banner** — full-bleed gradient strip with the brand tagline
- **News Carousel** — 4 horizontally-scrollable cards with category tag pills, titles, dates; prev/next arrow buttons, dot indicators, drag-to-scroll, and touch/swipe support
- **CTA Download** — App Store + Google Play buttons
- **Footer** — 7-column grid (brand + About/Features/Safety/Community/External/Partners), language selector, 6 social icons, legal links

**Key interactions:**
- Hamburger opens a full-screen overlay nav with smooth fade+slide animation
- Carousel supports: click arrows, click dots, mouse drag, touch swipe, scroll-snap with live dot sync
- Scroll-reveal animations on all major sections
- Header gains shadow on scroll
